summary.zh: 修复 modelswap skill add 交互选择器:之前的 prompts 调用方式在该库版本上不存在,交互模式一打开即崩溃;已切换为与 vault 交互流程一致的对象式调用并实测通过。
summary.en: Fixes the modelswap skill add interactive picker: the previous prompts calls used an API that doesn't exist in prompts@2 and crashed on open; switched to the object form proven in the vault flows and verified end-to-end.

highlights.zh: 修复:运行 modelswap skill add 进入交互选择时立即报错(prompts.select is not a function)。现与 vault 交互流程使用同一套成熟调用,选择 Agent、勾选技能、落盘安装全流程在伪终端实测通过。
highlights.en: Fixed: entering the interactive picker crashed immediately (prompts.select is not a function). Now uses the same object-form prompts calls as the vault flows; verified end-to-end in a pseudo-TTY.

highlights.zh: 交互与参数两种安装路径的行为对齐:跳过已存在技能的提示、--force 覆盖、未知技能/agent 的报错文案在两条路径下完全一致。
highlights.en: Interactive and flag-based install paths now behave identically: skip notices, --force overwrite, and unknown skill/agent errors all share the same wording.

highlights.zh: 随附 v1.0.81 技能文档的安装闭环(交互 skill add / 参数直装 / npx 与手动拷贝)一并随本版本 npm 包分发。
highlights.en: Ships the v1.0.81 skill-doc install loop (interactive skill add / flags / npx & manual copy) in the npm package with this release.
